newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Pryca gains almost 3 percent after results.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Pryca gains almost 3 percent after results.

text.p: Spain hypermarkets chain Pryca shares were outperforming the general index with gains of about three percent on Wednesday after reporting 1996 results.
At around 1215 GMT, Pryca shares were up 75 pesetas to 2,680 off the high at about 2,710. Other dealers added the gains should be capped near these levels.
"They are buying Pryca after good results, but it seems to me an expensive stock," a dealer in Madrid said.
Earlier on Wednesday, Pryca announced a net profit at 23.95 billions pesetas, up 10.2 percent.
